column1: # Provenance of every .ifc fixture under test/fixtures/.
# Checked by crates/ifc-model/tests/fixture_provenance.rs: every fixture needs exactly
# one row, every row must name an existing file, and an upstream row's
# `identical` flag must agree with the SHA-256 of the local bytes.
#   source          upstream: URL pinned to a commit; derived: the fixture it
#                   was edited from; generated: the generator, repo-relative;
#   upstream_sha256 upstream: SHA-256 of the upstream bytes at `source`; else -
#   identical       upstream: yes | no (byte-identical to upstream); else -
#   note            how the file came to be, in one line
